svg.title: Sector boundary: current Si-W and ALLEGRO-style DD4hep barrel models
svg.desc: Matched native ROOT navigator XY material/sensitivity slices at z=0. Si-W sector4 plus two neighboring half-sectors, and the same45degree view of the current continuous inclined-period LAr model. Geometry images are embedded native rasters; annotations are vector.
